House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for housing with support for persons with serious mental illness.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; HOUSING WITH SUPPORT FOR PERSONS WITH SERIOUS MENTAL ILLNESS. +]

[+$4,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $4,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services to provide adult mental health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.992, to support increased availability of housing options with supports for persons with serious mental illness. This appropriation is added to the base. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; appropriating money for housing with support for persons with serious mental illness.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; HOUSING WITH SUPPORT FOR PERSONS WITH SERIOUS MENTAL ILLNESS.

$4,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $4,500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services to provide adult mental health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.992, to support increased availability of housing options with supports for persons with serious mental illness. This appropriation is added to the base.

This appropriation is added to the base.
